response.rationale: The product provides a legal name: 'Potato crisps, lightly salted', which is a customary and descriptive name for this type of food and is not merely a brand or fancy name. The quantitative indication (QUID) is present for all ingredients, including those that appear in the name ('Potatoes' and 'Salt'), with their respective percentages clearly stated in the ingredient list. This satisfies both the requirement for a legal/customary/descriptive name and the QUID requirement when an ingredient appears in the name of the food.

citations.quoted_span: The indication of the quantity of an ingredient or category of ingredients used in the manufacture or preparation of a food shall be required where the ingredient or category of ingredients concerned: (a) appears in the name of the food or is usually associated with that name by the consumer;
